title: Decentral EZ
tagline: A decentralized launchpad for DAOs. From education to tools this is made for everyone.
description: This project uses a straightforward UI to allow a nontechnical individual to create a simple DAO, where individuals can join, create proposals, vote with a predetermined quorum, and grow in governance rank based on participation. Features are customizable upon initiation. Smart contracts can be upgraded over time when members reach consensus on proposals.
how_its_made:
This project used Reach Platform to create a blockchain agnostic application with only 350 lines of code. this application is deployed to Optimism, Polygon, Moonbeam, and Klaytn. 

here's the app: 
- Create a DAO
    - each DAO has its own rules; some can require a membership fee, and some may not
- Predetermine voting quorum
DAO Actions: 
- Check if I am a member
- Check my rank (if I am a member)
- Create a proposal
- Check current proposal info
- Short text post (128 chars)
- Comment on text post (256 chars)
- Join 
- Leave
- Register a proposal 
- Support a proposal
- Oppose a proposal
